components.name: Lens Option
components.description: A selected or unselected lens in the compact view switch.
components.css: .ds-lens-option { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-ink-3); color: var(--color-text); font: 11.5px 'Archivo Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-lens-option:hover { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-lens-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-frontend); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lens-option:active { background: var(--color-ink-2); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact repository search field with a quiet leading mark.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-ink-0); color: var(--color-faint); } .ds-search input { min-width: 210px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 12.5px 'Archivo Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-faint); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-rule-strong); } .ds-search:focus-within input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-frontend); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: A semantic category toggle with swatch and count.
components.css: .ds-category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink-2); color: var(--color-text); font: 11.5px 'Archivo Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-category:hover { border-color: var(--color-rule-strong); } .ds-category:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-frontend); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-frontend); } .ds-category small { color: var(--color-faint); font: 10px 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Architecture Node
components.description: A graph component block with category identity, label, and source path.
components.css: .ds-node { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; width: 184px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-frontend) 38%, transparent); border-radius: 7px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-frontend) 9%, var(--color-ink-2)); color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-node:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-frontend) 75%, transparent); } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-frontend); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-node strong { font: 620 13px 'Archivo Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-node-kind, .ds-node code { color: var(--color-dim); font: 10px 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-node-kind { color: var(--color-frontend); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }

components.name: Details Panel Header
components.description: A stable title and source identity block at the top of node details.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); background: var(--color-ink-1); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-panel span { color: var(--color-frontend); font: 10.5px 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 8px 0 4px; font: 680 22px/1.2 'Archivo Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-panel code { color: var(--color-dim); font: 11.5px 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
Eyrie is a precise instrument for seeing a codebase from above. Its interface is quiet and information-dense: graphite surfaces recede, thin rules organize the frame, and semantic colour marks the structure that matters. The graph itself is the image; controls and chrome stay legible without competing with it.

The map remains alive as source code changes. Motion reports those changes and helps preserve orientation; it is never ambient decoration. The visual language should feel precise, quiet, technical, alive, and trustworthy. It should not resemble a marketing dashboard, a mind-mapping toy, or a generic node editor.
keyCharacteristics: A fixed, full-height instrument shell around a pannable architecture map.
Category colours are semantic claims; each hue keeps one meaning.
Real repository identifiers use monospace; Eyrie's prose uses Archivo.
State changes remain legible without colour alone.

rules.name: The One Hue, One Meaning Rule
rules.body: A category colour is never decorative or reassigned to another category. Define every new colour in both schemes and derive state tints with color-mix(in oklab, ...) where possible.

rules.name: The Meaning Has Two Channels Rule
rules.body: Never communicate a change or edge type with colour alone. Change state also has a +, ~, or − badge; edge kinds use line patterns as well as colour.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for literal repository data and sans serif for Eyrie's interface language. Do not blur the distinction.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and a one-pixel rule to separate ordinary layers. Reserve shadows and glow for the 3D model or a selected graph element.

dos: Do preserve the UI → Edge → API → Logic → Data → External lane order.
Do define colour tokens for both dark and light schemes.
Do use monospace for source paths, routes, line numbers, and symbols.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and honour reduced motion in CSS and JavaScript.
Do use colour together with a badge, dash pattern, label, or other non-colour signal.
Do preserve stable node identity and position when code outside the changed region is unchanged.
donts: Don't use category hues as decoration or swap their meanings.
Don't add ambient movement or animate unchanged graph layout.
Don't use shadows as the default separator for panels and controls.
Don't shrink graph nodes to fit a narrow viewport; let the lane ruler indicate off-screen content.
Don't lower tertiary text contrast below 4.5:1 on its neutral surface in either colour scheme.
